stage_progress.title: Minimal Product Event Contract
goals: define only product signals with demonstrated producer and measurable consumer ownership
separate product telemetry from canonical music-domain and privileged audit authority
establish privacy, retention, sampling and persistence gates before raw event storage is allowed

stage_progress.title: Favorites & Collections Closure
goals: audit MVP user-value ownership before adding persistence or UI
reuse existing account/catalog boundaries where possible

stage_progress.title: Recent & Local State
goals: add recent searches/views only when telemetry and privacy semantics justify them
prefer bounded local/browser state where server durability is not required
define governed anonymous-to-account behavior before sync

stage_progress.title: Retention Measurement Closure
goals: derive measurable return-value metrics from accepted product signals
close retention evidence without recommendation or notification overreach
close Stage 27 through existing exact-head verification ownership

work_lease_policy.authority: live Git branch + GitHub pull request
work_lease_policy.rule: Never store volatile PR/head state as authored progress. AI must resolve the live branch/PR before writing; an existing active PR for the same semantic owner is resumed instead of duplicated. Stage work uses one umbrella branch while logical tranche ownership remains explicit in this plan.
